cohort: 18 pregnant women referred to the department due to a gradual onset of inguinal swelling and groin ache
finding: The diagnosis of an inguinal hernia with a first symptomatic onset during pregnancy may be wrong in most cases, and round ligament varicosity should be considered as a differential diagnosis.
mod_finding: All women gave uncomplicated birth to single children, one by caesarean section.
followup_time: Postpartum (approximately 2 weeks after delivery) and at 11 months
